HistoryInsertBindPlan decomposes each insertable slot directly; ordinary EntityUpdateBindPlan skips UNFETCHED_PROPERTY. Thus a title-only update can carry the untouched lazy String sentinel into JDBC binding for the new history version. The adjacent descriptor refactor and historical-read fix do not replace this code path. Runtime confirmation is still pending.
